vibe_rationale: Long-running national tattoo and art festival with a loyal community, a little more commercial because a consumer health brand presents it.
fit_notes: Strongest precedent in New Zealand: Bepanthen, a skin-care brand, already presents it, proving a health brand partnership, though that top slot is taken. The adult tattoo audience has aftercare and skin-health angles, but age is not published and the only attendance figure dates from 2019; it is a New Zealand event.
